title: Ash on the key
line1: The garage key survived the fire. Your sibling did not come home.
line2: Marrow holds the debt and the lease on your shelter.
line3: The young Mechanic keeps one light burning for you.

title: The first invoice
line1: Your first receipt buys more than another night indoors.
line2: The Mechanic marks the part that will help this car.
line3: Keep the receipt. Marrow keeps a different copy.

title: Loose ground
line1: Scree cuts the tires. The workshop floor catches the dust.
line2: A bare frame sits beneath a quarry dispatch drum.
line3: The Mechanic says the frame is for someone who has nothing.

title: A sealed box
line1: Relay needs a sealed gearbox carried through the sluice.
line2: The job is optional. The prize still pays if you refuse.
line3: Inside its lid is a crew name scraped off the debt book.

title: A local debt
line1: Rook collected leases before racing for Marrow.
line2: The crews need to see you hold a line under pressure.
line3: Rook watches from the pit wall. This time you watch back.

title: Numbers under soot
line1: A short qualifier leaves time to prepare for Rook.
line2: Clear this qualifier to open the next pair of cars.
line3: Buy a car or develop this one. The contest names one rival.

title: Rook at the gate
line1: Rook puts the garage key beside the timing board.
line2: Win the boss race in first place against Rook to earn the crew endorsement.
line3: Rook will promote you with money or a car or a useful part.

title: Foundry row
line1: Rook writes your name on the crew buying account.
line2: A former collector has made your survival public.
line3: Ox needs that same protection for the foundry shifts.

title: Easy money
line1: A lender offers an advance against your next prize.
line2: The fixed fee is written where you can read it.
line3: The Mechanic will keep repairing your car without a loan.

title: Weight of a promise
line1: Ox races to keep the foundry furnaces lit.
line2: A heavy car can own a straight and still miss a turn.
line3: The crew has started counting your brake lights.

title: A second name
line1: Your sibling signed for a shipment under a false name.
line2: Mica recognizes the handwriting and saves the stub.
line3: The Mechanic asks you to bring every scrap home.

title: The crew account
line1: This longer shift pays the same open race schedule.
line2: Crew wages and your payments share a fleet account.
line3: Ox has the second receipts. Someone is paying twice.

title: Borrowed steel
line1: The short qualifier opens the Pro licence.
line2: Relay brings an honest serial plate from the yard.
line3: Ox asks for a public contest where every crew can watch.

title: Ox holds the line
line1: Ox lays both sets of receipts on your bonnet.
line2: Win the boss race in first place against Ox and the crew will back your climb.
line3: Stolen payments return as debt credit then cash still owed.

title: White horizon
line1: Ox has forced the collector to correct the books.
line2: Even if the debt is paid the stolen money belongs to you.
line3: The Mechanic keeps any wallet overflow safe on the account.

title: A dry footprint
line1: A shelter holds a glove stitched with garage wire.
line2: There is fresh oil on the thumb. Your sibling is alive.
line3: Vex carried someone north on the night of the fire.

title: Switch in the crate
line1: A sealed crate contains swapped ammunition.
line2: The Mechanic finds it before you leave the counter.
line3: The quarry dispatcher is now bolted to the bare frame.

title: Vex runs ahead
line1: Vex sells fast runs to drivers with nobody to trust.
line2: Marrow paid for the roadblocks on that northbound road.
line3: Vex wants proof that a new sponsor will leave it open.

title: The missing lap
line1: The flats make a long pressure run feel endless.
line2: Relay finds your payment listed as a fleet purchase.
line3: The theft bought the cars now enforcing the stolen leases.

title: Relay at dusk
line1: One short qualifier opens the Elite licence.
line2: Vex checks the courier route while you check the garage.
line3: The next car is a different tool. Its number is not a win.

title: Vex opens the throttle
line1: Vex places the northbound route on the timing board.
line2: Win the boss race in first place against Vex to earn a courier endorsement.
line3: Vex will carry your name and let the crews choose their road.

title: The mountain road
line1: Vex brings a recording with its missing lap restored.
line2: It shows a league tow truck at the burning garage.
line3: The Mechanic finally opens the locked workshop door.

title: The books
line1: Your sibling copied the books before the garage burned.
line2: Marrow paid the tow crew from the same fleet account.
line3: The debt was a way to buy the people collecting it.

title: A voice on the line
line1: Your sibling steps out from behind the parts shelves.
line2: The Mechanic hid them because Marrow searched every road.
line3: Fear kept the secret. Loyalty kept the door open.

title: Water over ink
line1: Mica gives each mountain crew a different ledger copy.
line2: No single seized car can carry all the evidence away.
line3: The dispatcher rig is one more thing built in pieces.

title: A remembered wreck
line1: A wet pressure run carries the copies past a checkpoint.
line2: Mica stays on the radio until the last crew answers.
line3: A racing grudge cannot cancel an earned endorsement.

title: No private deal
line1: The short qualifier opens the Champion licence.
line2: Marrow offers a private pardon in return for every copy.
line3: The Mechanic refuses to trade a person for a balance.

title: Mica tests the line
line1: Mica puts the crew signatures on the timing board.
line2: Win the boss race in first place against Mica to earn a public endorsement.
line3: The Crown gates must now admit the whole coalition.

title: Inside the gates
line1: Mica leads the crews through the Crown gates together.
line2: Rook has the sponsors. Ox has the receipts.
line3: Vex has the recording. The broadcast cannot be bought back.

title: The house cars
line1: The house cars wear the fleet account on their plates.
line2: They use bought parts and the same road you do.
line3: The Mechanic reminds you that a rating cannot choose a line.

title: A public account
line1: Relay reads both books over the open pit radio.
line2: Ox names each payment and where the money went.
line3: Marrow says a paid debt does not mean you own yourself.

title: The last shipment
line1: The Mechanic shows you the finished mine dispatcher.
line2: A quarry drum feeds real half-metre mines behind the rig.
line3: The engine is basic. The plan is to give you a chance.

title: Vex returns
line1: The longest Crown run keeps every crew in the stands.
line2: Vex sends the recording beyond the league transmitters.
line3: Marrow closes the exits and stops talking about money.

title: Before the Crown
line1: A short final qualifier brings your car to the pits.
line2: Marrow posts a forged ownership lien against it.
line3: The Mechanic rolls the rig out where you can see it.

title: Marrow on his road
line1: Marrow takes your car even though his books are exposed.
line2: The Mechanic gives you the basic rig and mine dispatcher.
line3: No lap victory. Fight until Marrow is the last wreck.

title: The garage is ours
line1: The crews return your car and tear up the forged lien.
line2: Your sibling opens the workshop beside the Mechanic.
line3: The endorsements become a league that belongs to its crews.
